test_title: PYST 143: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 31 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

STATEMENTS:

A. All boxes are pans.

B. Some boxes are jugs.

C. Some jugs are glasses.

CONCLUSIONS:

I. Some glasses are boxes.

II. No glass is a box.

III. Some jugs are pans.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d6ddaed44946228c42ba91337015b48c8e47c7e881a6fd0ae2bcecd3fb79f8e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some glasses are boxes → **Does not** Follow (As, some boxes are jugs and some jugs are glasses. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. No glass is a box → **Does not **Follow (As, some boxes are jugs and some jugs are glasses. So, no direct or negative relation is given between boxes and glasses therefore it is definitely false.)

III. Some jugs are pans → Follow (As, all boxes are pans and some boxes are jugs. So, as whole boxers comes in pans and have some part common with jugs therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion III follows**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** 

There is conclusion I and II follows either or case but no such option is given in the question. So, it can not be the correct choice.
